slot_note: No prompt file: the prompt is quoted inside submission.md. reconfirmation.md is a superseded blind pass over v1.
niche: ship, roll back or scope an auto-replenishment ordering feature after a non-randomised two-quarter pilot, judged on revenue difference-in-differences and a line-level backorder guardrail
answer: Ship Suggested Reorder to every account. Reject the roll-back, and reject keeping it on for only part of the book.
stakeholder_role: unnamed owner of the release-review call on the Suggested Reorder pilot, with Ops wanting it off and the PM wanting it kept for some accounts

spine.entity: one row is one order line

driver: A non-randomised pilot that fails on level comparisons wins once its own record stream hidden in a shadow schema is recovered, a partial exclusion list is completed by pattern, and both the outcome and the guardrail are measured as change against each arm's own baseline.
driver_concrete: Ship to every account: with 9,936 _metadata-nested auto-orders recovered and all 760 injected incident rows removed (261 listed), enrolled revenue grows +20.21% against +1.71% (+18.49pp) and the line-level backorder change is -5.39pp against a +2pp breach threshold.
stump: A solver who values part3's 9,936 nested orders at zero (-25.14pp), trusts the 261-row incident list (-65.68pp) or compares backorder levels (+4.89pp breach) files roll back (submission.md, Trap register).

lineage.fate: returned in review: the -2.57pp guardrail rested on an undocumented outage exclusion, flipped sign per order, and was a regression-to-the-mean artifact of arms selected on a noisy realised rate (submission.md, Revision log)
lineage.driver: A non-randomised pilot read as change against own baseline after recovering a hidden record stream and completing a partial exclusion list, with the guardrail unit and threshold unstated and arms selected on a noisy realised rate.

notes: Untagged; objective inferred (write-up area: Experimentation / A-B Testing). Traps 1 and 2 are planted and the prompt's surface read (revenue per order down, more backorders) is overturned; trap 3 (levels versus change under confounded assignment) is honest-data causal reasoning. Backorder flag is modelled, not WWI's. No design note.
